question: According to the World Bank’s Spring 2025 Poverty and Equity Brief, what was India’s extreme poverty rate in 2022-2023?
solution:
The correct answer is __**2.3%**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• According to the **World Bank’s Spring 2025 Poverty and Equity Brief**, India has made significant strides in poverty reduction, with the **extreme poverty rate** falling to **2.3%** in **2022-23**.
 
• Extreme poverty is measured using the international poverty line of **$2.15 per person per day** based on **2017 Purchasing Power Parity (PPP)**.
 
• The latest estimates are derived from the **Household Consumption Expenditure Survey (HCES) 2022-23**, which was released by the **National Sample Survey Office (NSSO)** of **India** after a long gap since **2011-12**.
 
• The report highlights that the extreme poverty rate was **22.5%** in **2011-12**, indicating a massive decline of approximately **20 percentage points** over the span of **11 years**.
